what_happened: Cross-referencing specs/archive/497.../issues.jsonl and specs/archive/450.../issues.jsonl against orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh's Batch Gate Deferral emission code located a precise, narrowly-scoped composer defect (final-phase-only directive text) directly implicated by 3 primary-source issue-log entries, avoiding a broader/costlier rebuild of already-working Mechanism A/B or .gate-lock machinery.

validate-artifact.sh --strict caught two authoring defects in the first draft of plans/01_full-gate-batch-concurrency.md before return: backtick-leading wrapped continuation lines in two Files-to-modify blocks (read as prose, silently dropping no path but flagged), and three Tier Justifications that named a hand-picked suite subset narrower than suite_selection_select's own closure for the same touched paths. Both were fixed in place; the under-verification finding also drove Phase 3's tier up from interface to full, which is the honest tier for an edit to verify-deploy.sh itself.

Premise re-validation found a surface the research report did not name: context/formats/plan-format.md's '### Batch-aware deferral' subsection carries the SAME final-phase-only scoping in prose ('the final phase's own in-dispatch obligation narrows...') as the composer does in code. Fixing only the composer (research Recommendation 1) would have left the tier-declaration contract contradicting the mechanism. Phase 2 of the plan exists solely because of this check.

Phase 1 (widen Batch Gate Deferral to every full-tier phase) landed cleanly: the harness auto-backgrounded the scoped gate-8 check at its 120s default and the bounded kill-0 waiter idiom recovered the result without re-running or duplicating the call (27 selected suites PASS).

Phase 3's own smoke-testing accidentally created a self-inflicted gate-lock contention incident: 4+ overlapping manual verify-deploy.sh --only-gate 8 invocations were left running concurrently after the harness auto-backgrounded earlier foreground calls. Cleaned up via SIGTERM (the Phase 3 signal-scoped trap released specs/.gate-lock correctly, no stale lock left behind), then re-verified with a single clean invocation. Recorded because it is a live, if accidental, demonstration of the exact contention class this task addresses.

Phase 4's redeploy-and-verify fast-gate pass (gate 5, manifest-driven content-hash equality) reported 1 finding: 'core: Content differs from source: scripts/git-commit-scoped.sh'. Isolated and confirmed NOT attributable to this task: git-commit-scoped.sh was never touched by any of this task's edits, and specs/state.json shows task 476 (isolate_seven_red_gate8_shell_suites) concurrently in status=implementing -- a live sibling writer under the same batch invocation this task's own subject matter concerns, mid-edit on that file in the shared working tree. All 7 files this task's Phases 1-3 actually touched are confirmed byte-identical between source store and deployed copy. Recorded per Phase 4's own 'triage any finding by isolating this task's own edits; a finding not reproducible from these changes is recorded, not fixed here' instruction -- not fixed, not re-deployed over, left for task 476's own dispatch to land.
